metadata.title: Granular Pink Abstract with Expressive Lettering

retrievalProfile.description: A monochromatic magenta composition featuring a granular, sand-like 3D texture with sharp ridges and expressive, hand-drawn white lettering.
excludeWhen: a smooth or glossy surface is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast monochromatic scene dominated by vibrant magenta particles forming sharp, crystalline ridges and soft valleys, overlaid with raw, gestural white typography that appears hand-sketched.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast white text against a saturated magenta background
Granular micro-texture contrasting with large-scale abstract forms
Organic, jagged lettering mimicking the sharp edges of the particle terrain
Centralized typographic focus within a borderless abstract field

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary display text is centered horizontally and vertically, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, gestural 'PLAY' icon and text serve as the central anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central white lettering, then radiates outward following the sharp ridges of the pink texture.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The edges of the frame are filled with dense texture, creating a claustrophobic but energetic negative space around the text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation magenta with varying values created by light hitting the granular surface.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Expressive, jagged, and gestural uppercase forms
letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width with visible 'dry brush' or 'sketchy' edges
Sharp, aggressive angles and non-uniform terminals
Intentional overlapping of strokes within individual characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'P' features a disconnected bowl and stem
The 'L' has a sharp, upward-tilting base
The 'A' is constructed with a single jagged peak and a low crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large gestural display text paired with a dense block of small, intimate handwriting.
graphicDevices: Abstract play-button triangle icon in a matching sketchy style

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, energetic feel of the display text.
Mimics the small, dense handwriting block.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3D abstract landscape made of millions of tiny magenta particles. The terrain should have sharp, crystalline ridges and deep valleys, lit from the top to create highlights and shadows within the granular texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, hand-sketched white 'play' icon and the word 'PLAY' in a jagged, expressive style in the center. Below it, add a small, dense block of white handwritten text in a sentence-case format.

verificationChecks: Is the texture granular and sand-like?
Is the typography white and hand-drawn in appearance?

avoid: Low contrast between text and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the texture looks like physical particles, not just noise.
Verify the white text is legible against the magenta highlights.
Check that the hand-drawn style feels consistent across all text elements.
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite the abstract background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic Particle Texture + Expressive Hand-Lettering Overlay
